hypothesis: The cart-completion lock keyed by cart id uses the default in-memory locking provider, which only works inside one process. Completing the same cart simultaneously on two servers lets both pass the lock and the order_cart check, creating duplicate orders for one cart and double reservations.
submitted_scenario:
schema: oversold.scenario/v1
name: same-cart-two-servers
description: One cart is completed at the same time on two servers sharing a database.
target:
  engine: medusa
  version: 2.22.0
  servers: 2
stock:
  WIDGET: 10
carts:
  alice:
    server: 1
    lines:
    - sku: OVS-PIECE
      qty: 1
race:
- id: c1
  server: 1
  do: complete
  cart: alice
- id: c2
  server: 2
  do: complete
  cart: alice
timing:
  release: together
faults: []
runs: 10
seed: 1
